items.title: AWS Trainium Frontier competition: Co-design models and kernels on purpose-built AI chips
items.summary: Modern LLM architectures have co-evolved within a single hardware family. items.title: Announcing AA-AnalystAgent: an agentic benchmark for quantitative analysis on real-world spreadsheets and documents
items.summary: AA-AnalystAgent tests agents on 80 private quantitative analysis questions across 14 business and scientific domains, each answered from a folder of real source spreadsheets and documents. Every question is run five times and the headline metric is pass^5 — solved on all five attempts — because an analyst agent that is only sometimes right still has to be checked by hand.
